chunkscanner.help.title: ======== ChunkScanner Help ========
chunkscanner.help.content:
ChunkScanner — Asynchronous progressive chunk scanner

Commands:
  /cs task begin <name> [id] [config...]  Start scan
  /cs task stop <id>                     Stop scan
  /cs task pause <id>                    Pause scan
  /cs task resume <id>                   Resume scan
  /cs task stopall                       Stop all
  /cs task status                        View status
  /cs task list                          List analyzers
  /cs task gui                           Open task GUI
  /cs task help                          Command help
  /cs db gui                             Open database
  /cs db open [id]                       Open specific DB
  /cs db delete <id>                     Delete database
  /cs db reboot <id>                     Reboot scan from DB
  /cs db list                            List databases
  /cs db export raw <id> [name]          Export DB as ZIP
  /cs db export tsv <id> [name]          Export DB as TSV
  /cs config gui                         Open config GUI
  /cs config reload [quick]              Reload config
  /cs components qshop commitEnhancement Commit QShop enhancement
  /cs components qshop removeEnhancement Remove QShop enhancement
  /cs help                               Help

Shortcut alias:
  /csc qshop commitEnhancement          (= /cs components qshop commitEnhancement)
  /csc qshop removeEnhancement          (= /cs components qshop removeEnhancement)

Config format (begin): key=value ... (revisit=60 tasks=16 radius=1.0 wpName=Shop wpInit=$ wpGroup=shops)
ID/name parameters support double-quoted values, e.g. "my scan id".
